notes: 短剧节拍：番茄/红果/ReelShort/縦型等环境热门叶子。

craft.sentence: 对白短促；旁白极少；场面可拍
craft.avoid: 长内心独白、慢热铺垫超过两场
craft.lexicon: 你凭什么、当着大家、从今天起、我不同意

referenceParagraph.zh: 红毯麦克风还亮着。她把证件举起来：「婚，我拒绝。」掌声卡住，像被掐断。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 红毯麦克风还亮着。她把证件举起来：「婚，我拒绝。」掌声卡住，像被掐断。
referenceParagraph.en: The red-carpet mic was still live. She raised the papers: “I refuse this marriage.” Applause died mid-clap.
referenceParagraph.ja: The red-carpet mic was still live. She raised the papers: “I refuse this marriage.” Applause died mid-clap.

craft.sentence: 揭身份用物证/第三人；少解释段落
craft.stance: 爽感来自信息对称瞬间
craft.avoid: 无铺垫神豪空降、羞辱弱势群体
craft.lexicon: 你认错人了、合同在这、请他进来

referenceParagraph.zh: 保安还想拦，门口却响起「董事长到」。她把工牌翻面，字不需要念出声。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 保安还想拦，门口却响起「董事长到」。她把工牌翻面，字不需要念出声。
referenceParagraph.en: Security moved to stop her as “Chair’s here” rang at the door. She flipped her badge—no one needed it read aloud.
referenceParagraph.ja: Security moved to stop her as “Chair’s here” rang at the door. She flipped her badge—no one needed it read aloud.

craft.sentence: 一句一句砸；重复关键词强化伤口
craft.stance: 站在被压迫者情绪，但不煽动违法报复
craft.opening: 不公平条款或当众贬低
craft.avoid: 儿童伤害细节、过度血腥
craft.lexicon: 我退出、你选吧、从今以后、别再叫我

referenceParagraph.zh: 她把钥匙放在茶几上：「孩子跟我。房子你们争。从今以后，别再用家人两个字叫我回来。」
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 她把钥匙放在茶几上：「孩子跟我。房子你们争。从今以后，别再用家人两个字叫我回来。」
referenceParagraph.en: She set the keys on the table: “The child comes with me. Fight over the house. Don’t call me family to pull me back.”
referenceParagraph.ja: She set the keys on the table: “The child comes with me. Fight over the house. Don’t call me family to pull me back.”

craft.sentence: 证据出示即转折；台词服务围观
craft.avoid: 教唆犯罪细节、仇恨动员
craft.lexicon: 证据、公证、直播、你们看、结束了

referenceParagraph.zh: 发布会大屏切到邮件时间戳。他只说：「诬陷我的人，也在今天的邀请名单里。」
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 发布会大屏切到邮件时间戳。他只说：「诬陷我的人，也在今天的邀请名单里。」
referenceParagraph.en: The launch screen cut to email timestamps. He said only: “The people who framed me are also on today’s invite list.”
referenceParagraph.ja: The launch screen cut to email timestamps. He said only: “The people who framed me are also on today’s invite list.”

craft.lexicon: 你憑什麼、當著大家、從今天起

referenceParagraph.zh: 紅毯麥克風還亮著。她把證件舉起來：「婚，我拒絕。」
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 紅毯麥克風還亮著。她把證件舉起來：「婚，我拒絕。」

craft.stance: 爽感來自信息對稱瞬間

referenceParagraph.zh: 保安還想攔，門口卻響起職稱。她把工牌翻面。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 保安還想攔，門口卻響起職稱。她把工牌翻面。
referenceParagraph.en: Security moved as the title was announced at the door. She flipped her badge.
referenceParagraph.ja: 止めに来た警備の横で肩書が呼ばれた。名札を裏返した。

referenceParagraph.zh: 大屏切到郵件時間戳。他只說：「誣陷我的人也在邀請名單裡。」
referenceParagraph.en: The screen cut to email timestamps: “The people who framed me are also invited.”
referenceParagraph.ja: 画面がメールの時刻印へ。「陥れた人も、招待リストにいる。」
